faq.question: Q1. What is the conducting organization for Mahsul Sevak (Kotwal) Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The recruitment process is managed by the Revenue and Forest Department Ratnagiri in Maharashtra for filling up vacancies located in Mandangad with a total of 6 temporary positions.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available under this recruitment notification?
faq.answer: There are a total of 6 vacancies available for the Mahsul Sevak (Kotwal) post under the Revenue and Forest Department Ratnagiri recruitment drive for eligible and interested job seekers.

faq.question: Q3. What is the mode of application for Mahsul Sevak (Kotwal) Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must apply through offline mode by downloading the application form, filling it out completely, attaching required documents, and mailing it to the designated address before the final deadline.

faq.question: Q4. What are the start and last dates to apply for the recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process starts on 2 October 2026 and concludes on 17 October 2026. Applicants must ensure their documents reach the department within this specified timeframe to avoid rejection.

faq.question: Q5. What is the minimum educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed at least the 4th standard and possess adequate knowledge of the Marathi language to successfully qualify for the Mahsul Sevak (Kotwal) position.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for applicants applying for the post?
faq.answer: The minimum age requirement is 18 years and the maximum age limit is 40 years for all candidates applying for the Mahsul Sevak (Kotwal) recruitment openings in Ratnagiri.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application fee for General and OBC category candidates?
faq.answer: General and OBC category candidates are required to pay an application fee of Rs. 500/- as specified in the official recruitment guidelines issued by the department.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee relaxation for reserved categories?
faq.answer: Yes, SC and ST category candidates have a reduced application fee structure, requiring them to pay only Rs. 300/- for submitting their offline application forms.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for this government job?
faq.answer: The selection procedure comprises a Written Test followed by Document Verification and the subsequent preparation of a final Merit List based on overall candidate performance.

faq.question: Q10. When is the written examination scheduled to take place?
faq.answer: The written examination for the Mahsul Sevak (Kotwal) recruitment is scheduled to be conducted on 15 November 2026, following the scrutiny of applications and release of admit cards.
